name: @antfu/containers
description: Configs and setup for my personal container workflow, deployed with dev-container
author: Anthony Fu <https://github.com/antfu>

scripts.build: pnpm run build:toolchain && pnpm run build:paseo && pnpm run build:dev-base && pnpm dc generate && pnpm dc compose build
scripts.build:paseo: tsx src/cli.ts paseo prepare && docker build --build-arg NODE_IMAGE=paseo-toolchain --file .cache/paseo-build/docker/base/Dockerfile --tag paseo-base .cache/paseo-build
scripts.up: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm run vendor:setup && pnpm run build && pnpm dc up
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test --run
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && simple-git-hooks && pnpm run vendor:setup && skills experimental_sync -y

scripts-info.build:toolchain: Build the paseo-toolchain image (system packages, jup, uv, Rust, Chromium) that paseo-base is built on, so paseo changes never rebuild it
scripts-info.build:paseo: Apply services/paseo/patches to vendor/paseo in .cache/paseo-build and build the paseo-base image from it on paseo-toolchain, with upstream's own Dockerfile
scripts-info.paseo:edit: Turn the paseo patches into commits in .cache/paseo-work, rebased onto the pinned release
scripts-info.paseo:export: Write the commits in .cache/paseo-work back to services/paseo/patches
scripts-info.build:dev-base: Build the dev-base toolchain image that paseo starts FROM
scripts-info.knip: Find unused files, exports and dependencies
scripts-info.selfupgrade: Pull this repo and redeploy when it changed
scripts-info.daemon:install: Install the daemon that serves the dashboard, with an Upgrade button
scripts-info.up: Update everything and start: install deps, sync submodules to their pins, apply the paseo patches, build the images and start the containers
scripts-info.vendor:setup: Init the submodules and build dev-container
scripts-info.vendor:upgrade: Move the submodules to their latest remote commit
scripts-info.keys:setup: Generate the GPG keys paseo-bot and paseo-main sign commits and tags with, in keys/gpg/<identity>
scripts-info.ci: Run the full continuous integration pipeline
scripts-info.prepare: Set up git hooks and skills

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm run ci && pnpx nano-staged
